summary: Vodafone Group Plc filed a Form 6-K containing a UK TR-1 major-holdings notification after Societe Generale crossed the 9% disclosure threshold. The bank reported 8.996% of voting rights attached to shares (2,081,962,775 shares) plus 0.019% via cash-settled derivatives, for a combined 9.015% as of 29-Sep-2026, up from 8.901% previously. No board recommendation, advisor, premium or deal terms appear. This is a routine FCA transparency-disclosure update, not a special situation; watch for further stake changes by the bank.
